<img src="https://thirteenag.github.io/screens/gtasade/main2.jpg" width="760" alt="Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: The Definitive Edition Fusion Fix">

**Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: The Definitive Edition Fusion Fix** adds HUD and radar scaling, F5 quicksaves, startup skips, and mouse camera adjustments.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#gtasade) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/GTASADE.FusionFix/dllmain.cpp) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/GTASADE.FusionFix/Gameface/Binaries/Win64/scripts/GTASADE.FusionFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Options

- **Skip intro** — Skip startup intros.
- **Skip menu** — Skip the startup menu.
- **Quicksave** — Press F5 to save to the configured save slot.
- **HUD scale** — Adjust HUD and radar scaling in the INI file.
- **Mouse camera** — Corrected mouse camera movement.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the game’s installation folder, preserving its directory structure. The included files belong under `Gameface/Binaries/Win64`.
3. Optionally edit `Gameface/Binaries/Win64/scripts/GTASADE.FusionFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game.
